The evidence states that the number of valid child pointers (N) ranges from 1 to 8. It further states that 0 to 7 extra child pointers can be appended. Since the maximum number of pointers is 8, and N valid pointers are used, the number of available slots for extra pointers is indeed 8 - N. This matches the evidence's statement that 'from 0 to 7 extra child node pointers' can be concatenated, which corresponds exactly to the range of 8 - N when N is between 1 and 8.
